memoir.name: aoi-architecture
memoir.description: Architecture decisions and component relationships for aoi

concepts.name: AgenticOpsDashboard
concepts.definition: Nuxt 4 real-time dashboard for tasks and governed resource interaction

concepts.name: Dynamic Memory Constitution Snapshot
concepts.definition: Per-version governance artifact derived from the root constitution plus an owner-approved synchronization plan. Captures normalization, retention, and activation rules for one workspace memory version without forcing a semver bump on the root constitution for every import.

concepts.name: Memory Version Manifest Store
concepts.definition: Managed artifact tree under .specify/memory/versions that holds the active version pointer, immutable per-workspace memory version manifests, dynamic constitution snapshots, and templates required to activate or restore memory versions without ambiguous bare topic access.

concepts.name: Versioned Memory Sync Engine
concepts.definition: Workflow-first orchestration layer for cross-workspace ICM synchronization. It combines explicit sync and rollback prompts, version manifests under .specify/memory/versions, active-version resolution, dynamic constitution snapshots, owner-approved retain/complement/discard planning, deterministic Node helper scripts for activation and rollback, and full auditability across the workspace memory lifecycle.

concepts.name: Workspace Memory Rollback Path
concepts.definition: Recovery contract that reactivates a previously valid workspace memory version together with its resolver bindings, feedback scope, memoir mapping, and dynamic constitution snapshot when the active version is considered corrupt, inconsistent, or degraded.

concepts.name: Workspace Memory Version Resolver
concepts.definition: Resolves an explicit or active workspace memory version into concrete ICM topics, memoir names, feedback scopes, and constitution snapshot artifacts so prompts and runtime surfaces never read ambiguous bare memory aliases after synchronization.

concepts.name: agentic-ops-dashboard-locale-layer
concepts.definition: TASK-2026-003 adds a lightweight client-side locale layer to the existing dashboard so English and Spanish UI shell copy can switch immediately and persist locally while server payloads and source-of-truth data remain language-neutral.

concepts.name: agentic-ops-dashboard-nuxt-ui-shell
concepts.definition: TASK-2026-003 uses Nuxt UI 4.8.0 as the dashboard presentation layer: UApp at app root, UCard/UTabs/UAlert/UProgress for shell and task detail, UContextMenu for governed resource actions, and UModal for resource workflows. Backend/data contracts remain unchanged and live/scaffold parity is required.

concepts.name: agentic-ops-dashboard-operational-shell
concepts.definition: Operational workspace shell in apps/agentic-ops-dashboard/app/pages/index.vue that uses UDashboardNavbar and UDashboardToolbar above the existing UDashboardGroup to separate informative landing content from functional dashboard actions and navigation.

concepts.name: agentic-ops-dashboard-persistent-panels
concepts.definition: The dashboard workspace area uses UDashboardGroup and UDashboardPanel with local persistence. Column widths for tasks, detail, and resources are stored in local storage under agentic-ops-dashboard-columns, desktop users can resize them, and mobile keeps a stacked layout.

concepts.name: agentic-ops-dashboard-runtime
concepts.definition: Managed internal Nuxt 4 application under apps/agentic-ops-dashboard, mirrored under scaffold, serving a live workspace dashboard over authoritative task and resource files.

concepts.name: compressed-memory-bundle-workflow
concepts.definition: Workflow-first extension of workspace-memory-sync that transports a governed memory version as a gzipped JSON bundle with provenance, scope disclosure, integrity metadata, and import into the existing candidate-review-activate-rollback lifecycle without adding a second runtime state model.

concepts.name: constitution-source-of-truth
concepts.definition: AOI treats .specify/memory/constitution.md as the authoritative governance artifact. Related prompts, registries, supervisor routing, and scaffold mirrors must reference that path consistently to avoid workflow drift.

concepts.name: dashboard-resource-governor
concepts.definition: Server-side resource operations constrain writes to .resources, update the local constitution, and persist audit context in ICM.

concepts.name: dashboard-workspace-event-stream
concepts.definition: Nitro SSE route backed by chokidar notifications over .tasks and .resources for dashboard refresh.

concepts.name: dashboard-workspace-read-model
concepts.definition: Server-side snapshot layer that parses .tasks/registry.md, task artifact trees, and .resources into a normalized dashboard view with realtime refresh capability.

concepts.name: dual-sync
concepts.definition: All agents/skills must exist in both Copilot (.github/agents/) and Antigravity (.agent/skills/agents/) formats

concepts.name: dynamic-operational-workspace
concepts.definition: Agentic Ops dashboard uses a focused main stage with a contextual rail instead of three simultaneous heavy surfaces; task selection promotes detail view and the side-by-side composition activates from 860px upward to fit editor-sized desktop panes.

concepts.name: exportsmemories-base-directory
concepts.definition: Repository-level governed base directory for exported memory bundle artifacts. The compressed-memory-bundle workflow writes bundles under .exportsmemories/ in the live repo and scaffold/.exportsmemories/ in the installable template, while generated bundle payloads remain ignored by git except for tracked placeholders.

concepts.name: hub-and-spoke
concepts.definition: Supervisor orchestrates specialized agents per SDD phase

concepts.name: memory-bundle-contract
concepts.definition: Portable gzipped JSON envelope for workspace memory transport with source provenance, included and omitted scopes, and sha256 integrity metadata that feeds the existing candidate activation lifecycle through bundle-aware manifests.

concepts.name: resource-governance-workflow
concepts.definition: Proposed architecture concept for a governed internal resources subsystem: a default resources directory with its own scoped constitution, optional consumption by sdd-new, and a dedicated workflow to create, move, or remove resources while syncing constitution, registries, scaffold, and ICM.

concepts.name: resources-subsystem
concepts.definition: A governed optional .resources subtree that stores reusable user stories and component interaction definitions under a subordinate resources constitution, with explicit-only linkage during task construction and dedicated administrative workflows for structural changes.

concepts.name: sdd-lifecycle
concepts.definition: Spec-Driven Development lifecycle: constitution → specify → plan → tasks → implement → verify → archive

concepts.name: task-detail-modal-flow
concepts.definition: Agentic Ops dashboard now uses a full-width task board stage and opens task detail in a modal; operational context metrics are embedded in the detail informative section instead of a dedicated contextual rail.

concepts.name: task-resource-relations-record
concepts.definition: Canonical relations.json sidecar stored per task to represent explicit links from a task to .resources/userstories and .resources/workflows without heuristic parsing.
